content.comment_body: Good afternoon, What is the highest number of analog input modules I can connect to the [company_name] [product_name] [version_no]?

The [product_name] [version_no] supports up to 8 analog inputs. The total number of analog expansion modules depends on how many analog inputs are used on the base module, if the base module includes analog inputs.

The maximum is 8. Double-click on the selected [product_name] in the bottom right of the screen to view all details. You can also select an analog input in your workspace in [product_name] Soft, then click the analog input block and check Block Properties to see all available analog inputs, including the maximum.
Thanks, so if I use 4 analog inputs on the base module, I can only add 2 modules with 2 analog inputs each.
You can download a free selection tool to choose all [product_name] units and expansions. It also helps with the correct order number and configuration. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users asked about the maximum number of analog input cards supported by [product_name] [version_no]. The answer clarified that up to eight analog inputs can be used, combining the base module and expansion modules. Contributors described how to check the limits within the [product_name] configuration software and suggested using selection tools to ensure correct setup, highlighting users' reliance on additional resources for accurate information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward and easily accessible guidance on the total number of analog inputs and permissible expansion modules for [product_name] [version_no].
